newsitem.title: NORWAY: Storebrand Q1 results moved forward.
newsitem.headline: Storebrand Q1 results moved forward.

text.p: Storebrand ASA, Norway's largest insurer, said on Friday it was moving forward the announcement of its first-quarter results to April 29 from May 16.
Storebrand, in a statement to the Oslo Bourse, said it decided to move forward the date because of its planned merger with Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse ASA, Norway's second largest bank.
Christiania and Storebrand announced the merger plans on April 2. The new company, Christiania Group, would have a market capitalisation of 26 billion crowns.
The merger, if approved by shareholders and authorities, would form the country's largest financial group and the sixth biggest in the Nordic region.
